review_method: Manual review of every exported follow-up against its evidence_sentence after predicate-binding fixes.
quality_notes: All accepted questions have an explicit supporting evidence sentence from selected or retrieved corpus passages.

Two broader but grounded exploration prompts (Roosevelt consequence and Montmartre film-tourism purpose) were retained because their subject, predicate and answer are all explicit in the cited sentence.
Previously observed false positives from accent folding and unbound relation markers were removed before this review.
